title: Sir Keith Park Station
geometryBasis: The mapped shelter enclosure is 4.97 m wide by 3.47 m deep. The door faces the mapped platform and railway. The extent of the immediate apron is estimated.
sectionBasis: The public-domain Qualla original shows pale pink weatherboard siding, a dark open doorway, a brown flat-looking fascia, an off-white station board and a pale green bench. Dimensions of the roof, bench and openings are inferred from the photo and plan.
limitations: The station enclosure footprint comes from the current mapped polygon. The rear wall, threshold, exterior bench and roof slope are reconstructed from a single front view.
The unmodified terrain field provides approximate vertical placement at the threshold. The model includes the shelter and immediate apron.
